title: King of New York
about: A gangster returns from prison and tries to take over New York's underworld.
cue: Serve the mains when Frank checks into his hotel suite fresh out of prison.
faces: A black tie dinner to keep the hospital doors open
The South Bronx, looking south over the river to Manhattan.
Good evening, and welcome. It is good to be home. The city closed the books on this hospital. Tonight we open them again, and every dollar stays in the South Bronx.
With thanks to Jimmy Jump, Test Tube and Jennifer.
SERVED AT EIGHT, THE PLAZA BALLROOM

    StartersChinatown dumplingsPork and chive, fried crisp, black vinegar, soy and chilli oil.Sent up from downtown.How to make it12 frozen pork and chive dumplings1 tbsp neutral oil80ml water2 tbsp black vinegar1 tbsp soy sauce1 tsp chilli oilMix the black vinegar, soy sauce and chilli oil for dipping.Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat and pan-fry the dumplings until the bottoms crisp.Add the water, cover immediately and steam until cooked through (or the packet time), then remove the lid and let the water evaporate.Serve with the dipping sauce.Shrimp cocktailIced jumbos on shredded iceberg, sharp horseradish red sauce.On ice when you sit down.How to make it500g green prawns125ml tomato sauce2 tsp horseradish1 lemon1 iceberg lettuceWorcestershire sauce, a dashPoach the prawns in simmering salted water.Plunge into iced water, peel and chill.Mix the tomato sauce, horseradish, juice of half the lemon and a dash of Worcestershire.Fill 4 glasses with shredded iceberg, hang the prawns over the rims and spoon the sauce in the middle.MainsRib eye au poivreSeared and rested, brandy cream pepper sauce, pommes frites.Medium rare unless you say.How to make it800g potatoes800g rib eye steak, in four pieces1 L neutral oil, for frying1 tsp cracked black peppercorns40ml brandy150ml beef stock100ml thickened creamsalt, to tasteCut the potatoes into thin frites, rinse and dry thoroughly.Fry the frites in oil at 140°C, then drain and cool.Fry again at 185°C until crisp. Season with salt.Pat the steaks dry and season. Sear in a heavy pan on both sides, then rest.Add the cracked black peppercorns to the pan, then carefully add the brandy away from the flame. Add the stock and reduce.Add the cream and simmer. Serve the steaks with the sauce and frites.SweetsNew York cheesecakeCream cheese, sour cream and lemon on a buttered crumb crust.Pledges collected at ten.How to make it120g digestive biscuits50g butter450g cream cheese100g caster sugar80g sour cream2 eggs1 lemonLine a 16cm springform tin and wrap the outside in two layers of foil. Crush the biscuits, mix with melted butter and press into the base.Beat the cream cheese with the sugar, then beat in the sour cream, eggs and lemon zest. Pour into the tin.Set the tin in a roasting pan with hot water halfway up its sides. Bake at 150°C until the edges are set and the centre gently wobbles.Turn off the oven, leave the door ajar and cool inside.Refrigerate overnight, then cut into generous slices.DrinksChampagne cocktailsSugar cube, bitters and cognac under chilled brut.Passed at seven, at the reception.How to make it4 sugar cubes1 bottle aromatic bitters60ml cognac1 bottle brut champagne, chilled1 lemonPut a sugar cube in each flute and shake bitters onto each. Add cognac, top slowly with chilled champagne and twist a strip of lemon peel over each glass.
